lines: Philosophy - Faculty of Arts and Social Science

Completion of first-year requirements with no failures. Students must have an average of at least 70% in 3.0 principal courses, with no mark in these principal courses below 60%. 1.0 course from Philosophy 1230A/B, Philosophy 1250F/G, Philosophy 1350F/G, Philosophy 1370A/B, is recommended.

3.0 courses: Philosophy 2200F/G, Philosophy 2202F/G, Philosophy 2250 or Philosophy 2252W/X, Philosophy 2500F/G, Philosophy 2700F/G, (Philosophy 2250 or Philosophy 2252W/X must be completed by the beginning of third year).
1.0 course from: Philosophy 2812F/G, Philosophy 2813F/G, Philosophy 2820F/G, Philosophy 2821F/G, Philosophy 2822F/G.

2.5 courses from: Philosophy 2253A/B, Philosophy 2263F/G, Philosophy 3170F/G, Philosophy 3220F/G, Philosophy 3250F/G, Philosophy 3625F/G, Philosophy 3645F/G, Philosophy 3880F/G, Philosophy 4820F/G; and both of Philosophy 3710F/G and Philosophy 3720F/G.
1.0 course from: Philosophy 3501F/G, Philosophy 3620F/G, Philosophy 3810F/G, Philosophy 3820F/G, Philosophy 3840F/G, Philosophy 4850F/G, Philosophy 4851F/G, Philosophy 4855F/G.
1.5 additional courses in Philosophy at the 3000 level or above.
